query: SELECT g.source_id, g.ref_epoch, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pm, g.pmra, g.pmra_error, g.pmdec, g.pmdec_error, g.pmra_pmdec_corr, g.parallax_pmra_corr, g.parallax_pmdec_corr, g.radial_velocity, g.radial_velocity_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.phot_g_mean_flux_over_error, g.bp_rp, g.phot_bp_mean_flux_over_error, g.phot_rp_mean_flux_over_error, g.ruwe, g.phot_variable_flag, a.teff_gspphot, a.teff_gspphot_lower, a.teff_gspphot_upper, a.teff_espucd, a.teff_espucd_uncertainty, a.teff_esphs, a.teff_esphs_uncertainty, a.teff_gspspec, a.teff_gspspec_lower, a.teff_gspspec_upper, a.radius_flame, a.radius_flame_lower, a.radius_flame_upper, a.radius_gspphot, a.radius_gspphot_lower, a.radius_gspphot_upper, a.lum_flame, a.lum_flame_lower, a.lum_flame_upper, a.distance_gspphot, a.distance_gspphot_lower, a.distance_gspphot_upper FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS a ON a.source_id = g.source_id WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', g.ra, g.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 331.096653, -56.800663, 0.033611)) AND (g.pm > 2000 OR 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', g.ra, g.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 331.096653, -56.800663, 0.010000)))
